description: Merged Waifugami helper: passive card tracking, team analysis and a Components V2 card browser, plus the spawn-name listener, event pings, series/tier tracking, and catalog maintenance. Formerly two separate cogs (WaifugamiCards and WaifugamiListener), now one cog with every command reachable under `[p]help wg`.
install_msg: Loaded Waifugami. Run [p]help wg to see every command. Legacy command names (wgstatus, wgwatch, wgtrack, etc.) still work unchanged.
short: Track cards, build teams, and get Waifugami spawn help
end_user_data_statement: Stores card information and team previews observed in Waifugami messages, pending acquisitions, collection state, the active team number, and the user's card-tracking preference (wg track clear deletes this). Also stores which series a user watches and which character ids a user tracks for completion, plus tier-alert DM subscriptions. Does not store message content beyond what is needed to parse Waifugami's own embeds.
